subject: Media Literacy
title: Aspirational Advertising
description: A micro-lesson that makes Aspirational Advertising usable.

hook.text: Nike doesn't sell shoes. It sells the idea that you could be the next great athlete.

buildup.text: Aspirational ads show you the person you want to be — and position the product as the bridge.

discovery.text: These ads exploit the gap between who you are and who you wish you were.

twist.text: The product can't close that gap. But the feeling of progress from buying it feels real enough.

climax.text: Aspirational ads sell hope, not products. And hope is infinitely renewable — so you keep buying.

punchline.text: You buy the dream. The product is just the receipt.

quiz.question: What do aspirational ads exploit?
options: The gap between who you are and who you wish you were
